constraints.name: element_all_ones_mask
constraints.description: Each element of the array must be of the form 2^x - 1 for some integer x with 1 ≤ x ≤ 60.

constraints.name: xor_sum_equals_target
constraints.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in the array must equal the given integer C.

constraints.name: minimal_array_size
constraints.description: The size n of the array must be the smallest possible size for which an interesting array with XOR sum C exists.
constraints.formal: n = min{ m | ∃ interesting array B of size m, ⨁_{j=1}^{m} b_j = C }
